summary: Tested the 3-step Sales Invoice Wizard in TallyDekho. All 8 feature requirements PASS. Wizard renders correctly across all 3 steps with proper field ordering, no default taxes, Payment Terms in Step 3 only, correct payment modes (Cash/Cheque/NEFT/Bank Transfer/UPI), and E-Way Bill transport chips.
critical_code_review_comments: MINOR: _onboardingShownThisSession is a module-level variable in _layout.tsx that resets on every page reload. Navigation from tabs to a stack screen (sales/create-invoice) can sometimes re-trigger the onboarding redirect. During testing, this was reproducible on certain navigation paths. Recommend adding a more robust onboarding completion state (e.g., AsyncStorage flag) instead of module-level variable.

MINOR: tally-sync Skip button calls signIn() but _layout.tsx has no explicit redirect from /(auth) to /(tabs) when isAuthenticated becomes true. The tally-sync screen stays stuck if the layout doesn't trigger navigation. This was worked around in testing but may affect real users.
